description: This file contains helper functions for testing the 'parallel-checkout' feature in a version control environment, including configuration setup and verification tasks.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets checkout configuration parameters: number of workers and threshold for parallelism.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command to checkout a repository and verifies the number of worker processes used during the checkout.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the working tree and index of a repository are correctly created and clean.
